from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetDisposalResult(BaseModel):
    """A company's non-current asset disposal gain/loss from a single financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The non-current asset disposal amount as reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount, e.g. '元', '百万元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item name from the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_asset_disposal_results: list[CompanyAssetDisposalResult]
